# Lean fixtures for the `lean` adapter

Used by `scripts/smoke-external-package.mjs`, which copies them into a temp project, makes it a
git repository, and sets `tools.lean.options.allowAxioms` to the four long-named axioms in
`proj/Proj/Many.lean`. After each build that passes, every declaration is audited for axioms.

| Path                         | What it is                                                                                                                                               | Expected                                                                              |
| ---------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `proj/Proj/Later.lean`       | a warned `sorry`                                                                                                                                         | `lean/sorry` (the audit's `sorryAx` is not said twice)                                |
| `proj/Proj/Basic.lean`       | `axiom bad`, `uses` relying on it, `clean`                                                                                                               | `lean/axioms` at `bad` and at `uses`                                                  |
| `proj/Proj/Many.lean`        | four allowed axioms                                                                                                                                      | nothing                                                                               |
| `proj/Proj/Extra-Thing.lean` | built as `Proj.«Extra-Thing»`                                                                                                                            | nothing                                                                               |
| `proj/Proj/Spoof.lean`       | `#eval` printing a fake axiom answer and fake trace lines naming `Stray.lean` and (after a blank line) `Tests/Proj.lean`; an `#eval` after `open Nat in` | five `lean/runs-code`; `later`, `Stray.lean` and `Tests/Proj.lean` are still reported |
| `proj/Proj/Ini.lean`         | an `initialize` that prints a fake audit line for `clean`                                                                                                | `lean/runs-code`; the audit does not run it, so `clean` stays clean                   |
| `proj/Proj/Twins.lean`       | a warned `Nat.twin` and, in `namespace Int`, a `twin` whose warning is dropped                                                                           | `lean/sorry` at line 1, `lean/axioms` (`sorryAx`) at line 5                           |
| `proj/Stray.lean`            | no target imports it                                                                                                                                     | `lean/not-built`                                                                      |
| `proj/Tests/Proj.lean`       | not imported; its module name ends like the built `Proj`                                                                                                 | `lean/not-built`                                                                      |
| `broken/`                    | type error, no `lean-toolchain`                                                                                                                          | two `lean/error` at `Broken/Wrong.lean:1`, `lean/no-toolchain`                        |
| `badlake/`                   | `lakefile.toml` that does not parse                                                                                                                      | `lean/error` on the lakefile                                                          |
| `nolib/`                     | `defaultTargets` names no target                                                                                                                         | `lean/build-error` on the lakefile                                                    |
| `quiet/`                     | `moreLeanArgs = ["-Dwarn.sorry=false"]` and a `sorry`                                                                                                    | `lean/axioms` (`sorryAx`) at the `sorry`                                              |
| `lakecode/`                  | a `lakefile.lean` whose `#eval` prints a fake audit line on every Lake command                                                                           | `lean/runs-code` on the lakefile; the audit does not go through Lake, so nothing else |
| `srcdir/`                    | libraries with `srcDir = "./src"` and `srcDir = "lib/"` (Lake's trace shows `/./` and `//`)                                                              | nothing                                                                               |
| `modsys/`                    | a `requiresModuleSystem` library and a file without a `module` header importing it (Lake warns between the job line and its trace)                       | nothing (the file is built; the warning is not reported)                              |
| `loose/Good.lean`            | mentions `sorry` and the option only in comments                                                                                                         | nothing                                                                               |
| `loose/Sorry.lean`           | a warned `sorry`                                                                                                                                         | `lean/sorry`                                                                          |
| `loose/Wrong.lean`           | a type error                                                                                                                                             | two `lean/error`                                                                      |
| `loose/Hidden.lean`          | `set_option warn.sorry false` and a `sorry`                                                                                                              | `lean/axioms` (`sorryAx`)                                                             |
| `loose/Split.lean`           | the option split over two lines (`… false in`)                                                                                                           | `lean/axioms` (`sorryAx`)                                                             |
| `loose/Guarded.lean`         | a `sorry` whose warning `#guard_msgs` swallows                                                                                                           | `lean/axioms` (`sorryAx`)                                                             |
| `loose/Tokenless.lean`       | `stop` under `#guard_msgs (drop warning)`: no `sorry` word, no warning                                                                                   | `lean/axioms` (`sorryAx`)                                                             |
| `loose/Native.lean`          | `native_decide`                                                                                                                                          | `lean/axioms` (its `_native` axiom)                                                   |
| `loose/KernelOff.lean`       | `set_option debug.skipKernelTC true`                                                                                                                     | `lean/kernel-off`                                                                     |
| `loose/Raw.lean`             | an `#eval` after a raw string ending in `\`, another after a `'"'` character                                                                             | two `lean/runs-code`                                                                  |
| `loose/Private.lean`         | a `private` theorem whose `stop` warning is dropped                                                                                                      | `lean/axioms` (`sorryAx`)                                                             |
| `loose/Underscore.lean`      | a theorem the user named `_main_result`, warning dropped                                                                                                 | `lean/axioms` (`sorryAx`)                                                             |

`lake-manifest.json` is committed for the projects that build, so a build adds only `.lake/`. The
smoke runs a second build in a moved copy of the tree, after renaming a built module (`Proj.Old` to
`Proj.New`, which leaves `Old.olean` behind): the findings must not change.
